instruction: Remember the first object on the conveyor, then pick the matching object when it appears again.

arguments.note: The first object is a blue-and-white keypad mobile phone. I will remember it and prepare a downward grasp while watching its travel.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is moving toward world +x, about 27 image pixels in 16 steps. I am finishing the downward orientation while letting the reference pass.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: I will wait above the phone's conveyor lane, leaving the belt unobstructed for subsequent objects.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The forward hover was refused; I will approach the lane in a shorter translation at the current height.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 15 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The reference phone continues off the right side. I am moving the hover farther over its lane before lowering.

calls.tool_result: left arm pose unreachable (planner status: Fail). The robot did not move; choose another pose. Neither arm moved.

arguments.note: The straight-down forward reach is limited; a slight forward tool tilt may provide a reachable interception pose.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: With the tilted wrist I will establish a lower hover over the belt, still clear of passing objects.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The reference phone is leaving the view. I will angle the idle wrist down to help inspect upcoming objects without touching the belt.

This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The reference has passed; I am holding the open gripper above the belt and watching for the next object.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s).

arguments.note: No new object is visible yet. I will return the idle wrist toward its initial viewing pose while the conveyor advances.

arguments.note: I am still waiting for a repeat of the blue keypad phone, keeping the interception hand safely above the lane.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. arguments.note: The belt is still clear in the central view; I will continue observing as it advances.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: A round green-and-black object is entering from the left. It does not match the remembered keypad phone, so I will let it pass.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The entering object is a figurine on a round base, not the phone. I continue waiting above the belt.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The figurine continues rightward and is not a match. I leave it untouched and keep watching for the phone.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: Neither the figurine nor the small bright-green item matches the blue-and-white phone. I continue to let them pass.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The matching blue keypad phone has appeared behind the green item. Its lane is nearer the front edge, so I will shift the hover over that lane and intercept as it moves right.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The hand stopped short near the tall distractor. I will raise it clear before aligning with the phone behind it.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 5 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is approaching the waiting hand from the left. I will turn straight down for a clean grasp across its narrow sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 12 waypoints (0.5s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is about a hand-width upstream and moving steadily right. I will lower to a clear pre-grasp hover after the distractor passes.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 8 waypoints (0.3s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is still upstream of the left gripper. I will keep that hand stationary above the belt until the phone reaches the interception point.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: the original plan contains 21 control steps; only its first 20 will execute before the next observation. The remaining steps will not execute automatically. This prefix may end before the target or before a scheduled gripper change; the next observation reports actual execution and target error.

arguments.note: The matching phone is approaching the open jaws. I will descend to just above its top, preserving clearance while checking alignment.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 3 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is still left of the interception point. I hold the left hand above it while the conveyor brings it beneath the jaws.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 16 waypoints (0.6s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone has reached the jaws. I will follow its rightward motion and lower toward its sides, with a small lane correction.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 2 waypoints (0.1s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The wrist view shows the phone still left of the jaw centre. I will correct laterally and lower only four millimetres near its top.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is partly beneath the left finger rather than centred. I will lift slightly to avoid blocking it and let it advance into the gap while returning the idle arm home.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 6 waypoints (0.2s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is moving into the jaw gap. I begin the final descent in four-millimetre increments.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone remains clear between the open fingers and continues toward centre. I lower another four millimetres.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone is nearly centred; I continue the controlled four-millimetre descent.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The matching phone is centred between the jaws. I lower four millimetres to bring the fingers alongside its body.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone now fills the centre of the jaw gap. I will track it a few millimetres rightward, lower four millimetres, and close around its sides.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 7 waypoints (0.3s). The last 6 move the gripper, once the arm has arrived. The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The jaws have closed against the matching phone and it has stopped moving with the belt. I will lift six millimetres first to verify the hold.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 1 waypoints (0.0s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.

arguments.note: The phone remains held securely between the jaws after the test lift. I will now lift it more than ten centimetres clear of the conveyor.

calls.tool_result: Accepted: playing 11 waypoints (0.4s). The next observation reports how close the grasp point landed.
